SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(o.ord_regdate, 'MM')) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, NVL(SUM(o.ord_price), 0) AS sales FROM order_tbl o WHERE o.ord_regdate >= TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND o.ord_regdate < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 12)
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.ord_regdate, 'MM') ORDER BY month

SELECT pc.cate_code, pc.cate_name, NVL(SUM(od.dt_amount), 0) AS quantity, NVL(SUM(od.dt_amount * od.dt_price), 0) AS sales FROM ordetail_tbl od INNER JOIN order_tbl o ON od.ord_code = o.ord_code INNER JOIN product_tbl p ON od.pro_num = p.pro_num INNER JOIN cate_tbl c ON p.cate_code = c.cate_code INNER JOIN cate_tbl pc ON pc.cate_code = NVL(c.cate_prtcode, c.cate_code) WHERE 1 = 1
AND o.ord_regdate >= TO_DATE(#{start_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND o.ord_regdate < TO_DATE(#{end_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY pc.cate_code, pc.cate_name ORDER BY sales DESC
